# The grid steps, exactly

The steps of the kernel's coordinate grid (chapter 6.1) and its tolerance ladder (chapter 6.5), computed by exact integer arithmetic from `geom-num`'s own constants: `GridStep::quarter_nm`, `grid::COORD_MAX`, `grid::COORD_BITS`, the unit constants, `GridStep::steps_per` and the `ladder` constants. Nothing is rounded: a value is written as a decimal only when its decimal ends, with every digit, and as a fraction otherwise. 1 mm is 4,000,000 quarter-nanometres; the inch is 25.4 mm and the US survey foot 1200/3937 m exactly (NIST Special Publication 811).

## The steps

Every coordinate is a whole number of steps within 2^40 − 1 = 1099511627775 steps (`grid::COORD_MAX`) of its frame's origin.

| Step | Quarter-nm | Size (mm) | Size (mm), decimal | Size (nm), decimal | Steps per mm | Step above ÷ this | Frame range, ± (m) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Q0 | 625 | 1/6400 | 0.00015625 | 156.25 | 6400 | — | 171798.69183984375 |
| Q1 | 25 | 1/160000 | 0.00000625 | 6.25 | 160000 | 25 | 6871.94767359375 |
| Q2 | 1 | 1/4000000 | 0.00000025 | 0.25 | 4000000 | 25 | 274.87790694375 |

## Common units on each step

Steps in one unit. "Not whole" means the unit is not a whole number of steps, so a length measured in it can fall between grid points; `GridStep::steps_per` gives `None` for it. The last column names `geom-num`'s constant for the unit, where it has one.

| 1/256 in | 0.09921875 | 635 | 15875 | 396875 | — |

## The tolerance ladder

Every tolerance in the kernel, in steps of the frame and in millimetres on each step.

| Tolerance | Steps | Q0 (mm) | Q1 (mm) | Q2 (mm) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Commit rounding per axis, at most (`ladder::COMMIT_PER_AXIS`, in half steps: 1) | 1/2 | 0.000078125 | 0.000003125 | 0.000000125 |
| Commit distance in 2D, certified ceiling (`ladder::COMMIT_DISTANCE_2D`) | 1 | 0.00015625 | 0.00000625 | 0.00000025 |
| Commit distance in 3D, certified ceiling (`ladder::COMMIT_DISTANCE_3D`) | 1 | 0.00015625 | 0.00000625 | 0.00000025 |
| Fit bound (`ladder::FIT`) | 64 | 0.01 | 0.0004 | 0.000016 |
| Per-operation bound (`ladder::PER_OPERATION`) | 16 | 0.0025 | 0.0001 | 0.000004 |
| Import healing, default (`ladder::HEAL_DEFAULT`) | 640 | 0.1 | 0.004 | 0.00016 |
| Import healing, cap (`ladder::HEAL_CAP`) | 6400 | 1 | 0.04 | 0.0016 |
| Short-edge warning (`ladder::SHORT_EDGE_WARNING`) | 3200 | 0.5 | 0.02 | 0.0008 |

Committing rounds each coordinate to the nearest step, moving it by at most 1/2 step (`ladder::COMMIT_PER_AXIS`), so a point of n coordinates moves by at most √n × 1/2 steps (Pythagoras). Each commit-distance ceiling c is checked to bound that exactly: n × (1/2)² ≤ c².

The angular bound (`ladder::ANGULAR`) is 2^-34 rad (`ladder::ANGULAR_LOG2`) = 1/17179869184 rad = 0.0000000000582076609134674072265625 rad, exactly, as an `f64` too: the fit bound (64 steps) divided by 2^40 steps (2^`grid::COORD_BITS`, one step more than the largest coordinate magnitude, 2^40 − 1).
